definitions.explanation: A condition that must be met or a qualification that is necessary. Commonly used in legal, business, and technical contexts.
An important or pressing matter that needs dealing with. For the business that brings someone to call or visit, the usual spelling is {用件|ようけん}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たしていない→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧。
examples.english: It does not meet the legal requirements.

examples.japanese: ⟦システム→システム：08428_shisutemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We will carry out the system requirements definition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{重要|じゅうよう}→重要：01575_juuyou⟧な{要件|ようけん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}します→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: I'll start with the important matters.

examples.japanese: {要件|ようけん}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}った→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I conveyed just the business matter and hung up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|いそ}ぎ→急ぎ：31762_isogi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{要件|ようけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{手短|てみじか}→手短：31852_temijika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I have an urgent matter, so please keep it brief.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 ({要件|ようけん} as requirement) is common in formal, legal, and technical writing. In IT, {要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧ (requirements definition) is a standard project phase. Sense 2 ({要件|ようけん} as an important matter) is mostly written; the polite ご⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ (what is your business?) is written with ⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {要件|ようけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{満|み}たす→満たす：09889_mitasu⟧: to meet requirements
- {要件|ようけん}⟦{定義|ていぎ}→定義：04789_teigi⟧: requirements definition
- ⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧{要件|ようけん}: application requirements
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧{要件|ようけん}: mandatory requirement

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧ (business, errand) is a homophone written with different kanji. ⟦{用件|ようけん}→用件：15058_youken⟧ is the purpose of a call or visit. ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧ (condition, terms) is broader and less formal than {要件|ようけん} in the "requirement" sense.
